report.ai.title: LionOrganizer report: which files are probably safe to delete?
report.ai.instructions.heading: Instructions for the AI
report.ai.instructions.intro: You are helping a person free up disk space. Below is a report made by LionOrganizer, a disk space analyzer, about the folder "{folder}". It lists files with their size, last-modified date and type, and the cleanup hints LionOrganizer found. File contents are not included. Please:
report.ai.instructions.rule1: Point out the files and folders that are most likely safe to delete, and explain why for each one (for example: an automatic backup, a temporary file, an installer that was already used, an exact duplicate).
report.ai.instructions.rule2: Sort them by the space they would free and give each one a risk level: low, medium or high.
report.ai.instructions.rule3: Do not recommend deleting files of installed programs, of the operating system or of drivers (for example under Program Files, Windows, /Applications or /usr): recommend uninstalling the program instead.
report.ai.instructions.rule4: Be careful with documents, photos, projects and anything that may be the only copy: say so when in doubt, and suggest checking or making a backup first.
report.ai.instructions.rule5: For exact duplicates (same SHA-256), recommend keeping one copy and say which one.
report.ai.instructions.rule6: End with a summary table: path, size, reason and risk.
report.ai.instructions.deleteNote: The person will delete the files in LionOrganizer itself, which moves them to the Recycle Bin and always asks for a confirmation code.
report.ai.instructions.format: Write every path exactly as it appears in this report, between backticks (`like this`), and the risk with one of these words: {low}, {medium} or {high}. The person can then paste your answer into LionOrganizer to select the files.
